text: 2026-08-03 local-axis implementation: DesignSchema.runwiseProjection now classifies every structural source column as SharedEstimand, RunLocalNuisance, RunLocalEstimand, Omitted, or NonEstimable and lowers a checked local CoefficientAxis. RunwiseOls selects source rows and columns from that projection; RunwiseFmriRunResult/FitBlock retain source-column mappings, run-scoped axes, rank evidence, and chunk merge checks. FixedEffects now intersects declared shared source columns, refuses shared support missing from any run under RequireAllRuns, maps ragged local coefficients/covariance into a selected shared axis, and carries mappings in sufficient statistics. Structural T/F evaluation can project a compiled full semantic contrast onto a structurally compatible fixed-effects subset without parsing labels. Added public fit.run-local-axes.v1 scenario with mixed TR, run-local intercepts, RetainZero missing cell, typed fixed-effects rejection, local mappings, rank evidence, and chunk equivalence; it passes JVM+JS. Evidence: designJVM/test 189/189, designJS/test 189/189, fitJVM/test 179/179, fitJS/test 171/171, focused RunLocalAxesScenarioSuite JVM+JS 1/1, manifest validator 25 entries, git diff --check clean. Independent small-matrix oracle and full P2.6 closure remain open.
